title: How Far Your Bike Wheel Travels in One Spin
description: Using circumference to figure out how far a wheel rolls in a single rotation.
narration_lines: Ever wonder how far a bike wheel travels in just one spin?
The distance around a circle depends only on its radius.
For a wheel with a seven inch radius, that's two times pi times seven.
That works out to about forty four inches in a single turn of the wheel.

params.footnote: pi (≈3.14) is just how many "radiuses" wrap around, doubled
